newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber SIR20 extends gains.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber SIR20 extends gains.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices rose further in moderate late trading on Thursday on market talk of expected lower supply in some key rubber producing regions, dealers said.
Dealers said February SIR20 offer prices edged up by another 0.25 cents/lb to 55.00-55.50 fob Medan, 54.75-55.25 fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang as well as 54.25-54.75 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
Dealers said foreign firms bought February/March SIR20 at 55.00 fob Palembang and at 54.75 fob Surabaya after the lunch break against the previous 54.50 fob Palembang.
Dealers said supply in Padang and Palembang semed to have edged down following recent rains, but supply in Medan and Kalimantan appeared to remain sufficient.
Latex dealers said high amoniac latex was on offer at 2,230 rupiah/kg fob in Medan for January deliveries.
